slots.name: Title IX hearings
slots.sentence: Cornell recently came out with an FAQ sheet, explaining it held 12 Title IX hearings into the alleged attack.

slots.name: Chi Phi closure status
slots.sentence: Cornell said temporary suspensions and other restrictions were immediately given to the men, and the Chi Phi frat has remained closed on campus since the incident.
